architecture.intervention: implement a temporal regularization term that penalizes over-reliance on recent recommendation outputs during model training
architecture.expected_effect: maintain recommendation diversity while preserving short-term engagement, thereby sustaining 90-day retention for mid-tail users within 2% of cold-start performance
architecture.falsification_test: compare retention metrics of two cohorts: one with the temporal regularization intervention and one without, measuring divergence from cold-start performance over time
